cohortFindings.semanticAdmission: PASS 10/10, counting the corpus-grounded REJECT for 東語西話 as a correct semantic outcome.
cohortFindings.lexicalUnits: PASS 10/10. Eight retained components are phrase-level units, the retained 佛性 formula is a genuine two-clause couplet, and 東語西話 correctly has no admitted unit.
cohortFindings.exactEvidence: REVISE — 17/20 stored KWICs verify exactly. The second witnesses for 赤心片片, 噇酒糟漢, and 曹源一滴水 must be recut.
cohortFindings.workIndependence: REVISE one row — 噇酒糟漢 cites X81n1571 and X82n1571, which are two volumes of the single work 五燈全書 (`work:wudeng-quanshu`), not two independent works. Independent witnesses exist and must replace the second citation.
cohortFindings.variantHandling: REVISE one row — the printed headword 欲識佛性義、當觀時節因縁 has zero exact hits. Its admitted corpus query 欲識佛性義，當觀時節因緣 has 157 hits in 97 works. The ledger notes the comma-form pair but must explicitly record both the separator resolution `、→，` and glyph resolution `縁→緣`; it must not claim all ten headword forms were exact-attested.

reviews.finding: Shengshou names it as the only work he knows, paired with medicine according to illness; Yuanwu independently makes it Bodhidharma's work and coordinates it with pulling nails and wedges. Both distinct-work KWICs verify exactly.

Baizhang uses it to withhold an inadequate formulation and Huangbo uses it in the separate Mazu succession test, with Baizhang confirming the appraisal. Both evidence bindings are exact and independent.

One occurrence is only a book title; the other compositionally says the aged master lacks strength to talk this way and that before stating his actual message. Neither raises, answers with, glosses, or adjudicates the string. Both negative witnesses verify exactly.

Yushan explicitly appraises raising the inherited matter, while Shanhui makes the same phrase the object of a direct test-question and caps it with an answer. Exact evidence and work independence pass.
Distinct critics apply the complete proverb to the Buddha's handling of cases. It functions as a case verdict, not free-standing moral verse; both witnesses verify and have distinct workIds.
